name: William
source:
One of the senior members of the literature club, William is a carefree student who rarely takes things seriously. Also a member of the club since his first year, he joined just to keep joking around with his best friend even after his morning classes ended. He holds his intellect in high regard, which adds to his image of an airhead jokester.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1042105862901440512] Twitter[/url]]
